The first release of spotini: a tiny, keyboard-first player for Spotify, for Windows. **Unofficial; needs Spotify Premium.** Try it in your browser at [berkutercin.github.io/spotini](https://berkutercin.github.io/spotini/).

## What's in it

- Liked Songs and all your playlists, search, album and artist pages
- Synced lyrics, a real queue, song radio, shuffle and repeat
- Make playlists and add songs to them from a right-click menu, several at once
- Every action on a key; media keys, the Windows media overlay, the tray and a taskbar mini player
- Shows up in your Spotify account as a device, so your Discord status shows what's playing
- Eleven palettes or your own colours
- Native and light: under 20 MB of memory while it plays

## Download

- **`spotini-setup.exe`**: installer (Start menu shortcut, uninstall from Settings).
- **`spotini-portable.exe`**: a single exe, no install.

The `spotini_<version>_x64-…` files are the same builds with the version in the name. All are built from this tag by [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/berkutercin/spotini/actions/workflows/release.yml); `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists their checksums.

These files aren't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC". Choose **More info → Run anyway**.

## First run

You need your own Spotify developer app (free, about five minutes). See [Setup](https://github.com/berkutercin/spotini#setup) in the README.
